svg.title: TensorNOODL algorithm: IHT loop and dictionary update
svg.desc: Diagram showing the full TensorNOODL algorithm flow: data generation with Rademacher factors, IHT sparse coding loop, and dictionary gradient update step with all mathematical formulas

g.text: Step I — Iterative Hard Thresholding (inner loop)
XS ← XS − 0.2 × ( A.T A · XS − A.T · Y_m )
gradient step, fixed c=0.2, pre-computed AtA = A.T A
hard threshold, fixed thr_c=0.1 (entries below 0.1 zeroed)
err.append( ‖XS − X_true‖_F / ‖X_true‖_F ) stopping: check every 3rd step, not consecutive
gr = (1 / pf) × ( Y_m − A · XS ) × sign(XS).T
